met_analysis:
The Well-Marked Low Pressure Area over southeast Rajasthan & neighbourhood weakened into Low Pressure area over Southwest Rajasthan & neighbourhood at 1730 hrs IST of today, the 01st August, 2026.
The associated cyclonic circulation extends upto 7.6 km above mean sea level tilting southwestwards with height. It is very likely to weaken gradually during next 24 hours.
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level continue to pass through Jaisalmer, centre of Low Pressure area over Southwest Rajasthan & neighbourhood, Banda, Dehri, Malda, thence eastwards towards Manipur.
The trough from southwest Rajasthan to northeast Bihar across centre of Low Pressure area over Southwest Rajasthan & neighbourhood, northern parts of Madhya Pradesh, southeast Uttar Pradesh and extends upto 4.5 km above mean sea level tilting southwestwards with height persists.
The offshore trough at mean sea level from South Gujarat to Kerala persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Northeast Assam & neighbourhood extending upto 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over southeast Himachal Pradesh & neighbourhood at 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The Western Disturbance as a cyclonic circulation over Himachal Pradesh & neighbourhood at 5.8 km above mean sea level persists.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over North Tamilnadu & neighbourhood and extends upto 1.5 km above mean sea level.
